# Sumba Rental Motorbike

> Motorbike rental on Sumba island, Indonesia, with the island's only airport-door delivery service. Sister brand of Bali Best Motorcycle. Bikes delivered straight to Lede Kalumbang Airport (TMC), West Sumba. Bilingual service (English / Spanish) for international travellers.

## Key facts
- Location: Sumba island, Indonesia (West Sumba)
- Unique selling point: only rental service in Sumba that delivers the bike to the airport door
- Delivery airport: Bandar Udara Lede Kalumbang (TMC), West Sumba
- Sister brand: Bali Best Motorcycle
- Contact: WhatsApp +62 881-0379-78255 (https://wa.me/62881037978255)
- Website: https://sumba.balibestmotorcycle.com

## Fleet
- BH Custom BH-G3: custom aluminium trail scooter. 300,000 IDR per day. Airport delivery included.
- Beach Buggy: coming soon — guided activity at Sandalwood Resort only.

## Booking and payment
- Book online; pay securely by card via Stripe Checkout.
- Price: 300,000 IDR per day.
